About Us TechMinds is an HR consultancy with a main focus on Tech &
IT. Your advantage: Through us, your application documents are sent
directly to the decision maker. In addition, you benefit from free
advice on all your career questions. And you get an authentic insight
into the daily work routine of your potential employer at an early
stage. Tasks You develop and improve the distributional forecasting
models of a growing software company in the grocery retail sector,
working across model architecture, calibration and coverage You deepen
existing production models, monitor forecast quality metrics
continuously and act quickly when performance degrades You identify
where current approaches reach their limits and shape what comes next
methodologically You make substantial contributions to the inventory
simulation and ordering policy framework and drive improvements
through to production You shape the technical direction in your focus
area, contribute to methodology decisions and hold a high bar for code
quality, testability and production readiness across the team You take
responsibility for end-to-end pipeline quality, from input data
integrity through forecast output to the performance of live order
recommendations, including regular backtesting and monitoring You ship
production-quality work with well-tested, readable and thoroughly
reviewed code, using agentic AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code,
Cursor) as part of your daily workflow You work closely with
engineering, product, sales and customer operations and translate
operational findings from store level into product improvements
Profile You hold an MSc or PhD in a quantitative field such as
statistics, mathematics, physics, operations research or computer
science You have built systems that make decisions under uncertainty
with real operational consequences, not just research prototypes Your
background is in at least one of probabilistic forecasting, stochastic
inventory simulation or operations research, with solid working
knowledge across the others You are deeply familiar with
distributional and probabilistic forecasting methods (e.g. quantile
regression, LGBM with distributional output, GAMLSS-type models,
conformal prediction) You have a solid grounding in stochastic
inventory theory, newsvendor models, related ordering policies and
service level optimisation You write production-grade Python and SQL
on large, messy, real-world data and have experience with ML model
evaluation and monitoring in production settings You are comfortable
working with GCP (BigQuery, Cloud Run, Vertex AI) and dbt, and you are
familiar with workflow orchestration (Airflow or Cloud Composer), Git,
containerisation and CI/CD You use agentic AI coding tools (Claude
Code, Cursor or similar) with daily fluency You translate complex
mathematical reasoning into decisions that product teams and
non-technical colleagues can act on You ideally bring experience from
supply chain optimisation, demand planning or retail, ideally combined
with startup or scale-up experience You are fluent in English; German
is not required Benefits You receive an attractive compensation
package including equity participation (VSOP) Home-Office
possibilities 30 vacation days You receive individual relocation
support if you are moving to Berlin Kontakt Further details apart from
the job description as well as information about the company are
available during the application process.

About us At No Isolation, we’re a profitable, 65-person Scandinavian
EdTech scale-up operating across Europe. We help educators bring
learning and belonging to every child. Our AV1 robot is deployed in 19
countries, with 5,000+ units supporting schools to improve attendance,
belonging, and continuity of learning for children who cannot be
physically present. Consistently described as life-changing, it
bridges the gap between the student and their peers, restoring both
educational continuity and the essential sense of social belonging.
We’re established enough to have a proven solution and strong
financial foundations, yet still small enough for every new colleague
to have a visible impact on our next stage of growth. The Opportunity

- Account (Sales) Manager (m/w/d) We are already quite established in
Germany. With 1,500+ units already deployed nationwide with almost no
churn across strategic customers, it’s a proven, trusted, and loved
solution - used by teachers who need a reliable way to include absent
students, welcomed by families who feel their child is still
"there,” and embraced by pupils who can see, speak, and belong
again. The references are real, and the impact is repeatable at scale.
Our next chapter is expanding our footprint in Baden-Württemberg - a
strategic, organic expansion that extends what already works. It
represents a massive and vital opportunity for our mission. We’re
bringing the same quality, reliability, and outcomes that defined
success elsewhere, and we’re looking for a sales professional to
play a pivotal role in driving growth across the region. As Account
Manager, you will set your strategic focus, open executive-level doors
across education and public authorities, and orchestrate
multi-stakeholder decisions. Your craft is relationships: You’ll
cultivate a high-trust network across all your stakeholders - engaging
in person to move complex decisions forward. You will lead with rigor,
listen with empathy, and with executive credibility, you’ll turn
early wins into lighthouse references, and lay the operating cadence
that keeps momentum compounding year after year. What You’ll Do
Define and drive your territory strategy: Build and execute the
go-to-market plan for your focus area within the region -
segmentation, territory mapping, prioritizing key accounts, and
setting milestones that turn strategic goals into tangible outcomes.
Build strategic executive relationships: Build trust with education
authorities, municipal leaders, and school executives - map decision
paths, align to policy and budget cycles, and secure multi-level
sponsorship. Win and expand strategic accounts: Lead full-cycle
acquisition and growth; align executive sponsors, budget owners, and
procurement; run multi-stakeholder close plans to signed agreements.
Lead with consultative, framework-led sales: Combine solution selling
with proven methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, SPIN, Challenger)
to pressure-test value, control timelines, and move from business case
to signed terms. Collaborate for seamless delivery and growth: Partner
with Customer Success, Marketing, and Product teams to ensure smooth
onboarding and implementation, capture outcomes, and turn success into
expansion and credible references. Create regional momentum: Build a
trusted partner network (associations, advocacy groups, integrators)
to accelerate adoption, and build visible presence by speaking at and
hosting conferences, roundtables, and policy forums to shape the
inclusion agenda. What You Bring New-business track record with
long-tail sales cycles (Germany): Solid B2B experience - creating and
closing multi-stakeholder deals, managing long cycles, and driving
consensus to close. Experience selling to the educational or public
sector will be a strong advantage. Executive relationship builder:
Ability to build credibility and earn trust from C-suite to school
leaders - advancing complex decisions through purposeful face-to-face
engagement and secure executive sponsorship. Strategic GTM & execution
discipline: Ability to build a targeted GTM strategy and turn it into
an operating rhythm - market segmentation, decision-maker mapping,
phased milestones, pipeline hygiene, and accurate forecasting
(HubSpot). Structured, consultative selling: Ability to run structured
discovery and build quantified ROI cases; experience with
methodologies such as MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, SPIN or Challenger is
beneficial. Language & location: Native-level German and professional
English; based anywhere within the Baden-Württemberg region. What We
Offer Proven platform: Expand within Baden-Württemberg with national
credibility, strong references, delivery expertise, and clear demand.
Territory ownership & autonomy: Own a key territory with significant
autonomy and decision-making responsibility. Growth & development:
Access to enablement, coaching, industry events, and opportunities to
help shape best practices as we grow in Germany. Tools &
cross-functional support: Work closely with Customer Success,
Marketing, and Product, with access to sales collateral, case studies,
and training. Scandinavian purpose-led culture: High standards,
meaningful work, and the freedom to do your best work. Highly rated
workplace: Engagement scores above benchmark, structured onboarding
with a buddy program, an annual company trip, and a collaborative
culture. Generous vacation: 27 days of annual leave plus public
holidays. Mobile & internet: Reimbursement for mobile phone and
internet subscriptions. JobAuto: Car leasing through salary sacrifice.
Annual company get-together: A yearly multi-day event focused on
connection, socializing, and memorable shared experiences.

Company Description About EIT RawMaterials As the world moves towards
a greener future, the demand for raw materials—minerals and
metals—is set to increase immensely over the next three decades.
Europe faces a critical challenge in securing a stable supply of these
essential resources. This challenge is where EIT RawMaterials steps
in. EIT RawMaterials is at the forefront of driving innovation and
sustainability in the raw materials sector. As an Innovation Community
within the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT), we
collaborate with over 300 partners across industry, academia, and
research institutes. Together, we forge dynamic, long-term
partnerships to develop innovative solutions that meet Europe's
growing demand for raw materials. About the Role We are seeking a
proactive and highly organized Administration Specialist (m/f/d) to
join our HQ office. In this role, you will be responsible for
coordinating a wide range of administrative, operational, and
organizational activities that contribute to the efficient running of
the office and support a positive employee and visitor experience. The
ideal candidate is detail-oriented, service-focused, and enjoys
managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment. You will work
closely with internal stakeholders, external partners, and leadership
teams to ensure seamless administrative processes and excellent
operational support. Your Responsibilities Office Management &
Administration Manage the day-to-day administrative operations of the
HQ office Ensure the office environment is well-maintained, organized,
and fully operational Coordinate office supplies, equipment, and
vendor relationships Prepare and manage correspondence, letters, and
official documentation Maintain records, administrative files, and
internal databases Support document management and filing processes
Meeting & Event Coordination Organize and coordinate internal
meetings, workshops, training sessions, and company events Manage
meeting schedules, invitations, agendas, and logistics Prepare meeting
rooms, materials, and presentations as required Coordinate catering,
external service providers, and event-related vendors Support the
successful execution of employee engagement activities and corporate
events Travel & Logistics Management Coordinate domestic and
international travel arrangements, including flights, accommodation,
transportation, and itineraries Support visitors and business guests
with travel and logistical arrangements Ensure travel documentation
and administrative requirements are completed on time Assist with
travel expense administration and reporting processes Administrative &
Operational Support Provide administrative support to management and
cross-functional teams Coordinate incoming and outgoing correspondence
and deliveries Support procurement and purchase order administration
Assist with invoice processing and vendor-related documentation
Contribute to the development and improvement of administrative
processes and procedures Stakeholder & Visitor Management Serve as a
point of contact for office-related inquiries Welcome and support
visitors, partners, and external stakeholders Coordinate
onboarding-related administrative activities for new employees when
required Foster a professional, welcoming, and service-oriented office
environment What You Bring Completed vocational training or degree in
Business Administration, Office Management, Hospitality Management, or
a related field Several years of experience in administration, office
management, executive support, or a similar role Excellent
organizational and coordination skills with strong attention to detail
Ability to manage multiple tasks while maintaining high-quality
standards Strong communication and interpersonal skills Proactive,
reliable, and solution-oriented approach Proficiency in Microsoft
Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) Experience
working with administrative and procurement processes is an advantage
Fluency in German and English What We Offer A diverse and impactful
role at our HQ office An international and collaborative working
environment Opportunities to contribute to office operations, employee
experience, and organizational effectiveness Professional development
and learning opportunities Flexible and modern workplace environment A
supportive team culture that values initiative, collaboration, and
continuous improvement Application Process Overview The position will
stay open until a successful candidate is chosen. Application Review:
Our team thoroughly reviews each application. Please make sure to
submit your CV in English. Initial Interview (30 minutes): Meet with
the hiring manager and HR team. Second Interview (60 minutes): Second
interview with a presentation on a relevant topic to the hiring
manager and the HR team. Offer: If successful, receive an offer to
join our team.

Job Description: Techtronic Industries (TTI) is a world leader in
cordless technology spanning power tools, accessories, hand tools,
outdoor power equipment, as well as floorcare and cleaning products.
Our focus is on end-users that range from professionals in the
industrial, construction and infrastructure sectors to DIYers in home
improvement, repair, and maintenance. TTI’s powerful brand portfolio
includes MILWAUKEE®, RYOBI®, AEG® – recognized worldwide for
their deep heritage and innovative product platforms of superior
quality. The company maintains a global manufacturing and product
development footprint, with record world-wide sales of approximately
US$15.2 billion and around 50,000 employees in 2026. Hiring
exceptional people is a top focus at TTI. This drives a
high-performance culture across all levels of our organization and
helps to achieve our vision of being number one in the industries we
serve. Our unique high-speed decision-making process supports our
acute focus on developing superior products and meeting high customer
expectations. We view our winning culture as a competitive advantage
that powers our growth. To strengthen our team in Winnenden (Stuttgart
area) as soon as possible, we are looking for a Sustainability Data
Analyst (f/m/d) Your role: Collaborate with business stakeholders and
leadership teams to gather requirements, develop, and support data
modelling and BI solutions for organizational stakeholders Integrate
different data sources into a cohesive data fabric, ensuring data
consistency, accuracy and reliability Conduct business analysis
activities to understand business user requirements and translate data
and information flows within business processes Analyze
sustainability, quality and regulatory data to identify trends,
patterns and areas for improvement Provide insights and
recommendations based on data analysis to support informed
decision-making in sustainability initiatives Perform data profiling,
validation and cleaning to ensure accuracy, completeness, and quality
of enterprise data Maintain data quality standards and enforce data
governance policies, standards and best practices Maintain clear
documentation for data orchestrations, highlighting their value and
contribution to improved data modeling and governance Your profile:
Bachelor's or similar degree in Data Science, Environmental Science,
Sustainability Management, or a related field, or equivalent
professional experience Proven experience with Power BI, Power
Automate, VBA, C++ programming, Python, and SAP QuickViewer Good
communication skills in German and English, both written and spoken
Knowledge of Qlik Sense and IBM Envizi is considered an advantage
Relevant experience in data analysis, reporting, and data
visualization Your perks: An interesting position with an attractive
company – recognized as a "top employer” by kununu Free parking
spaces directly next to the office and good public transport
connections Fresh fruit, water and hot beverages for free Company
fitness via "EGYM Wellpass” Bicycle leasing via "JobRad” EAP
(mental support for employees) Learning platforms such as
"GoodHabitz” and "Learn TTI” for your professional development
Special employee benefits via "Family & Friends” and additional
corporate benefit Are you interested? Then send your application via
our careers page. Naturally, we will treat your application with the
utmost discretion. We look forward to getting to know you! Techtronic

At HelloFresh, our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. As a global digital-native FMCG company and the world's leading mealkit provider, we are transforming the traditional food supply chain through a data-driven, on-demand model that enables scalable and more sustainable food delivery. The HelloFresh Group includes eight brands serving customers across multiple meal occasions, including HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, and Chefs Plate, as well as ready-to-eat meals from Factor and YouFoodz, meat and seafood subscriptions through Good Chop, and pet nutrition with The Pets Table. Through technology, data, and culinary innovation, we deliver personalized food experiences to millions of households worldwide.

The role

As a Lead Photographer in the HelloFresh Studio, you are part of our Photography team, working across food, product, lifestyle, and marketing productions. You are first and foremost an exceptional photographer with deep technical and visual expertise, setting the benchmark for photographic quality, craft, and production excellence across the Studio.

You lead through expertise, influence, and example, helping elevate the capabilities of the photography team while maintaining high standards across large-scale asset production. You play a key role in developing photographic talent, evolving ways of working, and driving continuous improvement.

You collaborate closely with Producers, Styling, Culinary, Post-production, and Creative teams to deliver high-quality and scalable visual production across multiple brands. You stay up to date with industry developments and actively support AI direction, experimentation, and content generation initiatives within the Studio and broader organization, helping translate new technologies into practical production workflows.

What you’ll do

- Lead by exampleand continuously raise the bar for photographic quality and execution across the Studio
- Execute and oversee food, product, lifestyle, and marketing photography to the highest commercial standards
- Coach, mentor, and support photographersthrough feedback, knowledge sharing, and hands-on guidance to elevate overall team capability
- Define, maintain, and continuously improvephotographic standards, shooting guidelines, and best practices
- Work together with Studio leadership to improve production quality, studio efficiency, and scalable ways of working
- Collaborateclosely with Art Direction, Styling, Culinary, Post-production, and Creative teams to ensure strong and consistent visual execution
- Support complex productionsand solve creative and technical and production challenges on set
- Drive consistencyacross large asset volumes while maintaining visual excellence and operational efficiency
- Actively contribute to Studio and company AI initiativesby supporting experimentation, developing practical use cases, and helping integrate AI-supported and hybrid content creation workflows
- Act as a trusted expertand escalation point for photographic quality, technical decision-making, and production excellence

What you’ll bring

- You are a seasoned photography professional with 7+ years of experience in commercial photography, ideally including food, lifestyle, product, and high-volume e-commerce content production
- You demonstrate exceptional photography craft and technical excellence. Providing a portfolio is mandatory
- You have deep expertise in lighting, composition, camera systems, color, production environments, and visual storytelling
- You have experience operating in fast-paced production environments and collaborating across multiple disciplines and stakeholders
- You naturally elevate others through coaching, feedback, mentorship, and sharing best practices
- Experience leading photographers or creative production teams is a plus
- You are highly influential, collaborative, and comfortable aligning stakeholders without relying on hierarchy
- You have a strong production mindset and continuously look for opportunities to improve workflows, quality, and efficiency
- You stay current with developments in photography, visual production, and AI-supported content creation, and understand how to apply new technologies in a practical production environment
- You have expert knowledge of Capture One and strong understanding of color grading and image editing. Experience with additional photography, automation, or AI-supported production tools is a plus
- You can interpret and deconstruct creative briefs and translate them into practical photographic approaches, balancing creative intent, production realities, and visual quality
- You have strong verbal and written communication skills in English

_________________

Please include a portfolio of your recent and relevant work.

Job Description

Join Us as a Site Contract Specialist – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation
We have successfully supported the top 50 pharmaceutical companies and more than 750 biotechs, spanning 2,700 clinical trials across 100+ countries in the last 5 years.

As part of our team , you’ll have the opportunity to prepare and negotiate contracts, as well as finalize the contract process. As a Site Contract Specialist, you'll liaise and establish effective relationships with sites and internal functional teams. You will ensure quality, objectivity, and risk analysis in the efficient delivery of contracts.

What You’ll Do:
• Drafts, reviews, negotiates and finalizes agreements with study sites in accordance with local/accepted process.
• Negotiates within approved parameters both investigator grant budget negotiation parameters, contractual terms and conditions in accordance with company contractual considerations, client contractual considerations, established process with sites and follows established escalation routes.
• Ensures compliance to established negotiation parameters, authority approval, contractual process and client expectations.
• Ensures compliance of budgetary guidance, templates and process.
• Identifies and assesses legal, financial and operational risks and escalates to appropriate level of the organization per established processes.
• Provides recommendations and alternative resolutions to Investigator Contracts negotiations through established escalation channels.
• Coordinates with internal functional departments to ensure various site startup activities are aligned with contractual activities and mutually agreed upon timelines; ensures alignment of contract negotiation process for sites and study are properly aligned to the critical path for site activation.
• Achieve target cycle times for site activations.
• Ensures guidelines and processes are followed for efficient escalation of out of parameter issues as appropriate.

Education and Experience Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification
• Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 2-5 years).
In some cases an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
• Good understanding of the principles of contract law, including a general understanding of laws that influence contract language, such as business, intellectual property and local tax and stamp laws
• Demonstrated ability to apply basic principles of investigator grant negotiation
• General understanding of business and financial principles that related to service agreements
• Effective communication skills (verbal & written) in English and local language
• Capable, with appropriate oversight, of drafting and negotiating contract provisions and budgetary issues within parameters
• Demonstrated ability in attention to detail
• Excellent analytical and decision based thinking skills
• Understanding of the pharmaceutical product development process and involvement of CROs
• Able to work independently or in a team environment
• Good organizational and time management skills
• Working knowledge of PPD SOP & WPDs
• Able to organize competing priorities logically and review outstanding contractual risk and issues
• Able to effectively use automated systems and computerized applications
• Ability to demonstrate a customer focused style of communication, problem solving and collaboration

Working Conditions and Environment:
• Ability to work in an upright and /or stationary position for 6-8 hours per day.
• Repetitive hand movement of both hands with the ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists.
• Frequent mobility required.
• Occasional crouching, stooping, with frequent bending and twisting of upper body and neck.
• Light to moderate lifting and carrying (or otherwise moves) objects including luggage and laptop computer with a maximum lift of 15-20 lbs.
• Ability to access and use a variety of computer software developed both in-house and off-the-shelf.
• Ability to communicate information and ideas so others will understand; with the ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences.
• Frequently interacts with others to obtain or relate information to diverse groups.
• Performs a wide range of variable tasks as dictated by variable demands and changing conditions with little predictability as to the occurrence. Ability to perform under stress. Ability to multi-task.
• Regular and consistent attendance.

jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the #1 ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work (https://www.bain.com/about/awards-recognition/) list and have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor’s list since its founding in 2009. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
